We can recognize that

\[
\frac{d}{dx}\left(\cos(x)^2\right) = 2*\cos(x)*(-\sin(x)) = -2*\sin(x)*\cos(x)
\]

Therefore,

\[
\int -2*\sin(x)*\cos(x)\,dx = \cos(x)^2 + C
\]

<answer>cos(x)**2 + C</answer>
